title: Dynamic Tensor Product Regression
abstract: arXiv:2210.03961v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this work, we initiate the study of Dynamic Tensor Product Regression. One has matrices $A_1\in \mathbb{R}^{n_1\times d_1},\ldots,A_q\in \mathbb{R}^{n_q\times d_q}$ and a label vector $b\in \mathbb{R}^{n_1\ldots n_q}$, and the goal is to solve the regression problem with the design matrix $A$ being the tensor product of the matrices $A_1, A_2, \dots, A_q$ i.e. $\min_{x\in \mathbb{R}^{d_1\ldots d_q}} \|(A_1\otimes \ldots\otimes A_q)x-b\|_2$. At each time step, one matrix $A_i$ receives a sparse change, and the goal is to maintain a sketch of the tensor product $A_1\otimes\ldots \otimes A_q$ so that the regression solution can be updated quickly. Recomputing the solution from scratch for each round is very slow and so it is important to develop algorithms which can quickly update the solution with the new design matrix. Our main result is a dynamic tree data structure where any update to a single matrix can be propagated quick

translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们开创了对动态张量积回归问题的研究。给定矩阵 $A_1\in \mathbb{R}^{n_1\times d_1},\ldots,A_q\in \mathbb{R}^{n_q\times d_q}$ 和标签向量 $b\in \mathbb{R}^{n_1\ldots n_q}$，目标是求解以这些矩阵的张量积作为设计矩阵 $A$ 的回归问题，即 $\min_{x\in \mathbb{R}^{d_1\ldots d_q}} \|(A_1\otimes \ldots\otimes A_q)x-b\|_2$。在每个时间步，其中一个矩阵 $A_i$ 会发生稀疏变化，目标是维护张量积 $A_1\otimes\ldots \otimes A_q$ 的一个概要，使得回归解可以被快速更新。每一轮都从头重新计算解是非常缓慢的，因此开发能够在设计矩阵更新后快速更新解的算法非常重要。我们的主要结果是一种动态树数据结构，对单个矩阵的任何更新都可以被快速传播（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文开创性地提出了动态张量积回归问题，并设计了一种动态树数据结构，使得当某个因子矩阵发生稀疏变化时，可以快速传播更新、高效维护张量积回归的解，而无需从头重新计算。
en_tdlr: This paper initiates the study of Dynamic Tensor Product Regression and introduces a dynamic tree data structure that allows any sparse update to a single factor matrix to be propagated quickly, enabling efficient maintenance of the regression solution without recomputation from scratch.
